title: Company Founded
description: Hironari Ohshiro founded Enagic (originally named 'Tokurei') in Okinawa, Japan. The company started as a specialized water technology business focused on water ionization.

title: First Commercial Water Ionizer
description: Launch of the first commercial-grade water ionizer, establishing Enagic as a pioneer in the alkaline water industry in Japan.

title: Japanese MHLW Medical Device Approval
description: Enagic's water ionizers received approval as 'Managed Medical Devices (Class II)' from the Japanese Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare - a significant milestone validating the health claims.

title: Launch of Leveluk Series
description: Introduction of the Leveluk series, which would become Enagic's flagship product line. The series brought advanced electrolysis technology to homes worldwide.

title: Global Expansion Begins
description: Enagic begins international expansion, establishing presence in the United States, Taiwan, and other markets. The direct sales/distributor model is adopted globally.

title: Enagic USA Established
description: Enagic USA, Inc. established in Los Angeles, California, serving as the North American headquarters and distribution center.

title: ISO 9001 & ISO 14001 Certifications
description: Enagic achieves ISO 9001 (Quality Management) and ISO 14001 (Environmental Management) certifications, demonstrating commitment to quality and sustainability.

title: Launch of Leveluk SD501
description: Release of the SD501 model, which becomes the world's best-selling water ionizer. Features 7 platinum-coated titanium plates and sets new industry standards.

title: Anespa DX Launch
description: Introduction of Anespa DX, the mineral shower system that brings hot spring experience to home showers, expanding Enagic's product portfolio beyond drinking water.

title: ISO 13485 Medical Device Certification
description: Achievement of ISO 13485:2016 certification for medical device quality management, reinforcing the medical-grade status of Enagic ionizers.

title: Enagic India Operations Begin
description: Enagic establishes authorized distributor network in India, bringing Kangen Water to the Indian market through certified representatives.

title: Launch of Leveluk K8
description: Release of the flagship K8 model with 8 platinum-coated titanium plates, large LCD touchscreen, voice guidance in 8 languages, and enhanced performance.

title: WQA Gold Seal Certification
description: Enagic water ionizers receive Water Quality Association Gold Seal certification for the US market, validating safety and performance claims.

title: NSF/ANSI Filter Certifications
description: Enagic's internal filtration cartridges achieve NSF/ANSI 42 and 53 certifications, confirming reduction of chlorine, lead, cysts, and VOCs.

title: 50th Anniversary & Global Presence
description: Enagic celebrates 50 years since founding. Operating in 40+ countries with 1+ million units sold worldwide. Continued innovation in water technology.
